cohort: 844 primiparous women with an uncomplicated singleton pregnancy
finding: Increasing maternal age, lower body mass index and lower bladder neck descent were associated with levator avulsion, while increased bladder neck descent and a family history of cesarean section were associated with levator microtrauma.
mod_finding: This study found that increasing maternal age, lower body mass index, and lower bladder neck descent were associated with levator avulsion during vaginal delivery.
